name: Cosrx Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Patch | Korea
description:
Cosrx Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Patches | Korea
Target and treat pimples effectively with Cosrx Acne Pimple Master Patch. These hydrocolloid patches help protect acne-prone areas from bacteria, reduce inflammation, and absorb excess oil, promoting faster healing.

Key Features:

Brand: Cosrx

Made in: Korea

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Size: 24 patches per pack

Ingredients: Petroleum Resin, Cellulose Gum, Styrene Isoprene Styrene Block Copolymer, Polyurethane Film, Polyisobutylene, Liquid Paraffin, Tetrakismethane

Usage: Cleanse the area, select a patch slightly larger than the blemish, and apply directly to the spot.

Effectively treat pimples while protecting your skin with Cosrx Acne Pimple Master Patch.
